device_entry.description: 这不是特定的物理实验设备，而是一个通用的 HTTP/REST 通信连接组件，用于在实验室软件与提供 Web API 的仪器、控制器或自动化系统之间发送请求并接收响应。
device_entry.description_en: This is not a specific physical lab device, but a generic HTTP/REST communication component used to send requests and receive responses between laboratory software and instruments, controllers, or automation systems that expose a web API.
